learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn how to read short stories attentively, extract important details (Who, What, Where, When, Why), and answer questions based on the text.]
warm_up_hook: 🕵️‍♂️ Put on your detective hats! Reading comprehension means being a story detective. We have to read carefully, find the hidden clues, and answer the mysteries at the end!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When you read an unseen passage, don't rush! Read it twice. The first time, just try to enjoy the story and understand what it is about. The second time, look for important details.
A good detective always looks for the 5 Ws: WHO is the story about? WHAT are they doing? WHERE are they? WHEN does it happen? WHY did it happen?
examples_or_templates: Passage: 'On Sunday morning, Rahul played cricket in the park.'
Clues: Who? (Rahul) When? (Sunday morning) What? (Played cricket) Where? (In the park)

lesson_modules.module_title: ✏️ Finding the Answers (प्रश्नों के उत्तर खोजना)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: When you read a question, find the 'keyword' in the question, and then scan the story to find that same word. The answer is usually hiding right next to it in the same sentence!
examples_or_templates: Question: 'What did the cat drink?' (Keyword: drink)
Text: 'The black cat drank cold milk.' -> Answer: The cat drank cold milk.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Read this: 'Tina loves apples. She eats a red apple every morning before school.' When does Tina eat her apple?
❓ Read this: 'The little dog hid under the bed because he was scared of the loud thunder.' Why did the dog hide?
options: He was playing hide and seek
He was scared of the thunder
practice_mcq_quiz.correct_answer: He was scared of the thunder

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Read the sentence: 'Sam went to the library on Friday to borrow a book about dinosaurs.' Question: Where did Sam go?
subjective_practice.hint: Look for the place mentioned in the sentence.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Using the same sentence, answer: What kind of book did Sam borrow?
subjective_practice.hint: Look for the word 'book' in the text and see what word comes after 'about'.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Using the same sentence, answer: When did Sam go?
subjective_practice.hint: Look for a day of the week!

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 Be the Author and the Teacher
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Write a 3-sentence story about an animal (e.g., 'Once there was a green frog named Hoppy. He lived in a big pond. He loved eating flies.'). Then, ask your parent two questions about your story and see if they get them right!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Read a passage at least twice: once to understand, once to find clues.
⭐ Always look for the 5 Ws: Who, What, Where, When, and Why.
⭐ Use keywords from the question to find the answer hidden in the story.
